analysis.statistics: descriptive medians and matched trial ratios only; no p95 or qualification claim
analysis.warmup: Fresh guest and receiver per session; all 3 registered trials retained. No JIT and no trial discarded.
analysis.pairing: same nominal size, trial, kind, exact object IDs and lengths across arms and phases; shared 7 operations only for fair arm comparison
comparisons: before-standard vs after-standard isolates implementation change
after-standard vs after-experimental64 isolates explicit rate profile
warm vs whole within each phase/profile
analysis.timing: operation encode through authenticated durable publication; exchange subset separately; lifecycle includes setup, boots, shutdown and keyless verification
analysis.cpu: Guest sender process and receiver processing separately; native orchestrator plus each worker exactly once; no guest/host sum and no energy claim
analysis.bytes: both directions canonical envelopes and framing; logical bytes and twice-logical two-hop physical stream bytes, excludes virtio credit/control headers

custody: Retain public result JSON, worker/journal receipts, stdout/stderr, exit and hashes. After verified exact result plus copied evidence hashes, remove only per-session owned receiver.ext4/cache.
